user.title: Connect BoxBlip

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the BoxBlip server: {error}

server_disabled.message: Home Assistant access is switched off on the BoxBlip server right now.

refresh.description: Fetches your parcels from BoxBlip now instead of waiting for the next check.
